evals.name: Semantic naming
evals.prompt: Create a color system for a SaaS dashboard
assertions: Has primary, neutral, success, error, warning

evals.name: OKLCH palette
evals.prompt: Generate a color palette that feels perceptually uniform
assertions: Colors feel equally bright at same lightness

evals.name: WCAG contrast
evals.prompt: Ensure all text in my design has sufficient contrast
assertions: Checks 3:1 for large text and UI

evals.name: Dark mode tokens
evals.prompt: Convert my light-mode colors to work in dark mode
assertions: Adjusts primary color for dark backgrounds
Maintains contrast ratios in dark mode

evals.name: Interactive states

assertions: Has disabled state with reduced opacity
